sn18.8:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Taṃ kim maññasi Rāhula || || Rūpataṇhā niccā vā aniccā vāti || || Aniccā bhante || || Saddataṇhā || Gandhataṇhā || Rasataṇhā || Poṭṭhabbataṇha || Dhammataṇhā ṇiccā vā aniccā vāti || || Aniccā bhante || || Evam passaṃ Rāhula sutavā ariyasāvako rūpataṇhāya pi nibbindati || saddataṇhāya pi || gandhataṇhāya pi || rasataṇhāya pi || phoṭṭhabbataṇhāya pi || dhammataṇhāya pi nibbindati || pe|| pajānātīti || || Aṭṭhamaṃ || ||
